cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The club's changing the menu. Keep that quiet before I tell you the bigger news.

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: She wants an uncomplicated evening. That's the kindest accurate sentence. Come have one with me.
